spec_case: issue #598 (secrets for a subprocess tool's host env)
description: A `{secret: api}` value in `runtime.plugins.awk.env` is resolved when the tool dispatches (an `env` secret here) and reaches the child's environment; the `--print-env` fake prints it, and the saved stdout and value have it replaced with `[secret:api]`. The value is a fake-credential marker, so the harness's own blanket check proves it reaches no --out, --events, --live-state, stdout or stderr. electricity resolves no secret yet and refuses the run with the preview marker.
